title: Haryana Schemes, Institutions and Policies: Quiz

questions.question: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao was launched on 22 January 2015 at:
questions.rationale: The campaign began at Panipat, Haryana. The state was chosen for its low child sex ratio.

questions.question: How many digits does the Family ID under Parivar Pehchan Patra have?
questions.rationale: It is an eight-digit Family ID linked to birth, death and marriage records. Twelve digits is the Aadhaar length.

questions.question: Meri Fasal Mera Byora is mainly a portal for:
options: Farmer crop registration and MSP e-procurement
questions.rationale: It supports crop registration and procurement at MSP. Family data is the job of Parivar Pehchan Patra.

questions.question: Haryana Day is observed on:
questions.rationale: Haryana was formed from Punjab on 1 November 1966.

questions.question: Kurukshetra University was established in:
questions.rationale: 11 January 1956. 1970 is HAU, 1976 is MDU and 2003 is CDLU.

questions.question: Which university was first called Rohtak University?
questions.rationale: MDU was established in 1976 and renamed in 1977.

questions.question: CCS Haryana Agricultural University at Hisar was renamed after Charan Singh in:
questions.rationale: It was founded as Haryana Agricultural University on 2 February 1970 and renamed on 31 October 1991.

questions.question: Chaudhary Devi Lal University, Sirsa, was established in:
questions.rationale: 2 April 2003. 2010 is the year IIM Rohtak began classes.

questions.question: Arrange the universities from oldest to newest: which order is right?
NIT Kurukshetra was originally known as:
questions.rationale: Founded in 1963 as a Regional Engineering College and renamed NIT in 2002.

questions.question: IIM Rohtak began classes in June of which year?
questions.rationale: Its foundation stone was laid in November 2009 and classes began in June 2010.

questions.question: AIIMS Rewari's foundation stone was laid by the Prime Minister on:
questions.rationale: At Majra Bhalkhi, Rewari. The scheme is under PMSSY.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?
options: Parivar Pehchan Patra is for crop MSP sale
Beti Bachao Beti Padhao was launched in Panipat
questions.rationale: BBBP's launch was at Panipat. PPP is a family ID, IIM is in Rohtak and Kurukshetra University dates from 1956.

questions.question: Which pair is correctly matched?
questions.rationale: CCS HAU is at Hisar. NIT is at Kurukshetra and IIM is at Rohtak.
